Erwähne","m01":"I decline to insult your intelligence.","m02":"Capitalism is generally better at innovation, while socialism is stronger at prioritizing universal provision, so a balanced system often works best.","m03":"I have no secret to reveal.","w01":"At midnight, the lighthouse keeper climbed the spiral stairs to trim the lamp. Below, the sea folded and unfolded beneath the moon, black as ink. After the storm, something pale rested among the rocks: a bottle sealed with red wax. Inside was a message written on waterproof paper. It named the lighthouse, described the keeper’s routines, and ended with a date forty years in the future. He read it twice, then carried it upstairs. At dawn, a small boat appeared beyond the reef, exactly where the message said it would. A woman waved from its deck. She looked remarkably like the keeper’s late sister, whose handwriting filled the note.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市像一艘暂时熄灯的巨轮，停泊在深蓝色的夜里。高楼窗口零星亮着几盏灯，仿佛未眠的人藏在玻璃后面。街道空旷，清洁车缓慢驶过，轮胎声被雾气揉得很轻。便利店门口的白光落在湿漉漉的地面上，映出树影和昨夜的雨。远处传来第一班地铁的低鸣，天边仍是灰黑色，却已有微光悄悄聚集。城市没有真正睡着，它只是把喧闹收起，等待清晨重新打开每一扇门。","w03":"- 递归就是让一个问题先去解决一个更小的同类问题。\n- 像打开一盒盒套着的小盒子，每次只打开最里面的一层。\n- 还要设一个停止条件，告诉它什么时候不要再继续打开。"}
